🌐 **Important update, new features, and free playtime**

⚠️ **Update to the latest version**, either via the automatic APK prompt or from Google Play.

🎮 **New cheat features**

You asked for it and here it is: cheats for everyone! 😄 EmulAItor now includes improved cheat compatibility, with automatic catalog options and the ability to enter cheat codes manually.

🎮 **Improved recognition of non-standard controllers**

EmulAItor now better recognizes some generic and non-standard controllers. This can help detect controllers that were previously unrecognized, but it's not magic ✨: many non-standard controllers may still not be detected properly, require manual mapping, or remain incompatible.

⏳ **Free playtime on Android TV**

If an ad cannot be displayed on your TV, EmulAItor will show the available alternatives. You can get free playtime from a phone or tablet: use the same Google account, keep synchronization enabled, watch a full ad in EmulAItor, and then return to your TV.

⚠️ Ad availability may vary by country, region, and ad provider. In some countries, AdMob is blocked and cannot show any ads. This is beyond EmulAItor's control, and an immediate solution may not be available. I continue to look for additional ad providers to offer a reliable free playtime alternative in those regions.
